text:
maria: Quick triage — seeing ~0.2% uptick in tool-call errors after router started sending traffic to q variants in eu-west1. Looks like function-call failures, not latency. Anyone dug in?

devon: I pulled traces. Filter: model_family="redwood-v2" variant=q4_0; tool_call_failures +10% last 24h. Errors show malformed JSON payload to tool runtime. :eyes:

raj: Heads-up — q4_0 was exported with a byte-level BPE tokenizer while the main v2 uses sentencepiece. Signature for tool-calls can change if tokenizer inserts/strips weird tokens around JSON blobs. Also some quant builds drop the function-calling shim for perf reasons.

anya: We should short-circuit router for requests that include `x-function-call` header. Proposal: if request.has_tool_call == true then only route to variants with `tool_call_compat=true`. Example router rule:```json
{
  "match": "request.metadata.tool_call == true",
  "priority": 100,
  "allowed_variants": ["fullprecision", "fp16", "q4_0_toolcall"],
  "fallback": "none"
}
```

lucas: Console UX: add a per-variant compatibility matrix with boolean flags: tokenizer_parity, max_context_parity, tool_call_parity. Also compute a compat_score (0-100). Show warning badge when a route would downgrade a request that needs tool_call_parity.

maria: Also need quota semantics: Dedicated customers (tier=reserved) should opt-in for variant fallback. Default = no-fallback for reserved tiers. Hosted customers get fallback but we must increment telemetry `fallback.routed` and tag the span with `fallback.reason=tokenizer_mismatch` or `toolcall_unsupported`.

devon: Telemetry additions I can add: - trace tag `variant_compat` (tokenizer/context/tool_call) - metric `fallback.routed` (labels: customer_tier, region, src_variant, dst_variant) - alert if tool_call_failures_by_variant_rate > 0.5% for 30m. Query example: `sum(rate(tool_call_failures[5m])) by (variant)`

sarah: For rollout UX: can we surface a canary dashboard that shows per-canary variant: requests_with_tool_calls, tool_call_success_rate, avg_latency, compat_score? Want a single panel to decide rollback.

raj: Quick note on context length parity — some variants truncate at 2048 tokens. If user's max_context > 2048 we need to either block fallback or synthesize a pre-routing error telling the app to reduce context or select a different model. Prefer explicit 4xx over silent fallback.

ops-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-042 — "tool-call parity regression after q-variant deployment in eu-west1". Pager duty notified.

anya: Next steps: (1) land router rule short-circuit for `has_tool_call` (devon + eng-runtime), (2) add telemetry tags + `fallback.routed` (devex/eng-platform), (3) console compat matrix MVP (lucas + product), (4) patch default quota behaviour to disallow fallback for reserved tiers (product + sales signoff).

maria: +1. Can we get a small PR today for the router check and a follow-up telemetry PR? If so I'll block the problematic q deploy.

devon: I'll open PR for router check in ~2h. I'll include unit tests that assert requests with `x-function-call` never route to variants where `tool_call_parity=false`.

lucas: I'll mock a compat matrix view and add a flag to the canary dashboard.

maria: Great — thanks all. We'll re-evaluate after the PRs land. :thumbsup:
